remarks: Nestled in a private waterfront community, this enchanting 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom cottage and barn has complete stunning water views and access to an array of recreational amenities. Featuring an open floor plan with vaulted ceilings and exposed original beams, this home blends rustic charm with modern convenience. The kitchen is equipped with stainless steel appliances and original maple cabinets, while the wide plank floors throughout add warmth and character. A one-car garage with a lofted barn and full bathroom behind the house provides additional storage or potential in-law suite, art studio or workspace. Outdoors, you are steps away from the association beach with panoramic views of the sound, a kayak launch and moorings, perfect for boating enthusiasts. The community also includes a ball field, playground, and tennis courts for active living. This home is a perfect blend of coastal living, comfort and convenience to South Norwalk trains, shops and restaurants - ideal for those seeking a peaceful retreat with community conveniences. Don't miss out on this rare opportunity!
